articles.title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
articles.summary: DETROIT — Audi's CEO defended the carmaker's plans for a new $4 billion plant in Georgia on Sunday, calling it a business decision aimed at growing sales and reducing exposure to U.S. The plant, set to be Audi's first in the U.S., was announced Saturday by President Donald Trump during a rally in Georgia, near where the Volkswagen-owned luxury brand plans to build the new SUV-producing facility. tariffs cost Audi 1.2 billion euros ($1.4 billion), as it imports all its vehicles for the U.S.
